batches.title: Foundation (scaffold + shared RPC)
batches.commitMessage: scaffold python monorepo and shared rpc layer

batches.commitMessage: add content service with file-backed repo and typed rpc client

commitPolicy: Logan commits at batch boundaries; executor never runs git commit and never stages docs/.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Repo scaffold & tooling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the Next.js scaffold with a uv workspace whose three service packages and shared rpc package install and run under Python 3.12.

**Verify:** uv sync && uv run python -c "import rpc, content_service, ai_service, web_service; print('ok')"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["pyproject.toml", ".python-version", "Procfile.dev", ".env.example", "rpc/pyproject.toml", "services/content/pyproject.toml", "services/ai/pyproject.toml", "services/web/pyproject.toml", ".gitignore", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "uv sync && uv run python -c \"import rpc, content_service, ai_service, web_service; print('ok')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["uv sync resolves workspace on 3.12", "all four packages import", "python artifacts gitignored", "Next.js files removed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Shared RPC layer (exceptions, client, server registry)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement the RPCError hierarchy, injectable ServiceClient, and server-side ToolRegistry + FastAPI router, unit-tested with a fake httpx transport.

**Verify:** uv run pytest rpc/tests -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["rpc/rpc/exceptions.py", "rpc/rpc/base.py", "rpc/rpc/server.py", "rpc/tests/test_client.py", "rpc/tests/test_server.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest rpc/tests -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["client sends bearer + returns json, sugar works", "status maps to RPCError subclass", "token cached", "registry validates + dispatches; unknown->404 bad->400", "router enforces 401"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Content contracts + repository + sample data
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Define content wire contracts in content_rpc and a ContentRepository Protocol (file-backed + in-memory), plus seed one real project (this website).

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/content/tests/test_repository.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["rpc/rpc/content_rpc/contracts.py", "services/content/content_service/repository.py", "services/content/content_service/data/projects/this-website.md", "services/content/content_service/data/projects/_placeholder.md", "services/content/tests/test_repository.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/content/tests/test_repository.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["contracts defined", "file repo renders body_html", "featured filter + NotFound", "in-memory repo matches"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Content service app + typed client
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire the repository into a FastAPI app exposing list_projects/get_project over /rpc/, and add the typed ContentRpcClient (ContentSource Protocol).

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/content/tests/test_app.py rpc/tests/test_content_client.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/content/content_service/config.py", "services/content/content_service/tools.py", "services/content/content_service/deps.py", "services/content/content_service/main.py", "rpc/rpc/content_rpc/client.py", "services/content/tests/test_app.py", "rpc/tests/test_content_client.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/content/tests/test_app.py rpc/tests/test_content_client.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["get_project ok/404/401", "health ok", "typed client parses + satisfies ContentSource"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: AI LLM provider abstraction
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Define LLMProvider Protocol + AnthropicProvider (base_url-pointable) + deterministic FakeLLMProvider, plus LLMTurn/ToolUse types.

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/ai/tests/test_llm.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/ai/ai_service/llm.py", "services/ai/tests/test_llm.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/ai/tests/test_llm.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["LLMTurn shape", "fake scripted+repeats", "anthropic maps blocks"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: AI chat orchestration + content-backed tools
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement the agentic tool-use loop (Chat.reply) and content-backed tool executor, depending only on LLMProvider + ContentSource abstractions.

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/ai/tests/test_chat.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/ai/ai_service/tools.py", "services/ai/ai_service/chat.py", "services/ai/tests/test_chat.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/ai/tests/test_chat.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tool specs", "execute_tool grounds + survives errors", "loop tool_use/end_turn/max_steps"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: AI service app + typed client
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose Chat as a chat RPC tool, wire config + DI (fake default, Anthropic when configured), add typed AiRpcClient.

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/ai/tests/test_app.py rpc/tests/test_ai_client.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/ai/ai_service/config.py", "services/ai/ai_service/rpc_tools.py", "services/ai/ai_service/deps.py", "services/ai/ai_service/main.py", "rpc/rpc/ai_rpc/contracts.py", "rpc/rpc/ai_rpc/client.py", "services/ai/tests/test_app.py", "rpc/tests/test_ai_client.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/ai/tests/test_app.py rpc/tests/test_ai_client.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["chat tool returns reply; health ok", "fake provider default no key", "AiRpcClient.chat returns ChatOut"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Web config, deps & client wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Give web its typed Settings and DI providers that build ContentSource and AiSource clients (the one place concretes are named).

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/web/tests/test_deps.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/web/web_service/config.py", "services/web/web_service/deps.py", "services/web/web_service/templating.py", "services/web/tests/test_deps.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/web/tests/test_deps.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["settings from env", "clients built", "templates configured"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Web routes, templates, HTMX & static assets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build /, /work, /work/{slug}, /chat with Jinja templates, an HTMX chat partial, vendored HTMX/Alpine, base CSS, and graceful degradation on backend RPC failure.

**Verify:** uv run pytest services/web/tests/test_routes.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/web/web_service/routes/home.py", "services/web/web_service/routes/work.py", "services/web/web_service/routes/chat.py", "services/web/web_service/main.py", "services/web/web_service/templates/base.html", "services/web/web_service/templates/index.html", "services/web/web_service/templates/work_list.html", "services/web/web_service/templates/work_detail.html", "services/web/web_service/templates/chat.html", "services/web/web_service/templates/_chat_reply.html", "services/web/web_service/static/styles.css", "services/web/tests/test_routes.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest services/web/tests/test_routes.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["home/work/detail render; missing->404", "chat partial returns reply", "graceful degradation no 500"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Dockerfiles + docker-compose (additive)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Provide a container path running all three services with one command, mirroring the honcho loop. Docker-gated; app already runs without Docker via honcho.

**Verify:** docker compose config >/dev/null && echo OK (skip with a note if Docker not installed)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["services/content/Dockerfile", "services/ai/Dockerfile", "services/web/Dockerfile", "docker-compose.yml", ".dockerignore"], "verifyCommand": "docker compose config >/dev/null && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dockerfiles build with uv", "compose defines 3 services + healthchecks", "compose config validates (docker-gated)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 11: End-to-end smoke test (full stack, in-process)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the whole system works together (web->content and web->ai->content) with a deterministic in-process test (no network/Docker/API key) via the injected-transport DI seam + fake LLM, plus a curl smoke script.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user as the v1 target ("runs cleanly ... locally"). Close only after every acceptance criterion has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Verify:** uv run pytest tests/e2e -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/e2e/test_stack.py", "scripts/smoke.sh", "pyproject.toml"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/e2e -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["home shows real content over RPC", "chat round-trips web->ai->content", "passes offline with fake LLM", "smoke.sh fails on non-200"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"]}
```
